summary: Star Equity Holdings (acquirer) entered a merger agreement on Aug 14, 2026, for its subsidiary Merger Sub R to merge with Harte Hanks, Inc. (target), making HH a wholly owned Star subsidiary. HH shareholders can elect $5.00 cash per share or 0.50 shares of Star's 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock per HH share; non-electing shares receive a mix as specified. The deal implies a defined per-share value, though premium is not stated. The board's recommendation and advisors are not mentioned. The transaction is subject to conditions, including shareholder approvals and regulatory clearances. Watch for election proration, closing timeline, and any competing bids.
